# Gala Roles {#sec-gala-roles}

For galas hosted by Alnwick Dolphins, we need a team of people willing to put time
into helping organise and staff the event.
On Swim Manager there is the facility to sign up to the different roles for a 
specific gala - there is no requirement to fulfill that role for more than one
gala, or for all days of multi-day galas (but obvioulsy it is easier to manage 
an event if the volunteers are the same on all days).

You don't need to be in any other named role to help with a home gala - sign up 
as you see fit!

The small (but crucial!) volunteer roles that are generally needed and change 
each time are:

## Gala-specific Roles

### 📋 Lead organiser

This person takes responsibility for ensuring the [gala checklist](gala-checklist.qmd) is
completed on time for their gala. 
They ensure each named and unnamed role is filled as needed, and often also perform the
role of Runner on the day. 
Each gala has its own Lead Organiser, and the role benefits from strong organisational
and timekeeping skills.
The organisation of a gala starts months before, so the time needed to perform
this role is more than some others. 

### ⏱️ Lead timing
Ensure the timing team is organised and has what they need before, and during
the gala. Escalate issues to the lead organiser.

### 📋 Lead poolside 
This person is responsible for ensuring all team managers and marshall roles
are filled and coordinated. Escalate issues to the lead organiser.

### 🎁 Raffle
Sell raffle tickets on the day and help to call the winners.

### 🎟️ Door
Sell spectator tickets for each session on the day.

### 🥇 Medal table
Am important role - use the printed results sheets from the timing team to
allocate the correct medals to the swimmers throughout the event.

### 🎤 Announcer

Use the sound system to announce all the events and housekeeping info on the day.


## Multi-Gala Roles

- [Team Managers](team-manager.qmd)

To host galas, we also need a whole set of Officials of various types - these are
really important roles that are essential for hosting our own galas, but they
do require a bigger commitment from volunteers.
Please have a look at the Officials page for more information.

- [Officials](official.qmd)
